digest.component_or_area: LLM provider seam / structured run / prompt cache warning
propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective fires on every sub-4096-token call with zero cache counters, despite 4096 being the documented minimum cacheable prefix size and the correct expected behavior below it
The warning cannot distinguish 'model does not cache' from 'prompt below the cacheable floor', causing alarm fatigue that masks the genuine opus-4-5 defect it was created to detect
Sub-floor calls generate ~20 false-positive warnings per rebar review-plan run, contradicting the run's own aggregate cache_write_tokens > 0 evidence that caching is working
The 4096-token floor constant is defined in pass1.py but not consulted by warn_if_cache_ineffective in structured_run.py, violating the codebase's own design invariant for cache behavior
